description: Defines utility template functions for summing and multiplying integers within containers and iterators, as well as calculating products of dimensions in multi-dimensional tensors.

methods.name: int64_t sum_integers(Iter begin,Iter end)
methods.description: Calculates the sum of all integer elements in a container, accumulating into a 64-bit integer to prevent overflow.

methods.name: int64_t sum_integers(const C & container)
methods.description: Calculates the sum of integer elements within an iterator range, accumulating into a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: int64_t multiply_integers(Iter begin,Iter end)
methods.description: Calculates the product of all integer elements in a container, accumulating into a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: int64_t multiply_integers(const C & container)
methods.description: Calculates the product of integer elements within an iterator range, accumulating into a 64-bit integer.

methods.name: int64_t numelements_from_dim(const int k,const C & dims)
methods.description: Returns the product of dimensions starting from index k, interpreted as the number of elements in a tensor slice.

methods.name: int64_t numelements_to_dim(const int k,const C & dims)
methods.description: Returns the product of all dimensions up to index k, representing cumulative size.

methods.name: int64_t numelements_between_dim(int k,int l,const C & dims)
methods.description: Calculates the product of dimensions between indices k and l, inclusive for k, exclusive for l, handling swaps if needed.
